decision_reason: Confirmed in source: ReseedSilo.reseedSiloDeposit L164 `s.accts[deposits.accounts].stalk = accountStalk` is a plain assignment, and init() calls it once per token (bean, beanEth, beanWstEth, bean3Crv, urBean, urBeanLp) over the same account keys. Any multi-token holder is overwritten on each subsequent pass, retaining only the last token's (urBeanLp) stalk. Sibling L2ContractMigrationFacet.setStalk uses += confirming the intended semantics. Deterministic per-user permanent loss of governance weight + earned-Bean share for the common multi-token holder. Provable by inspection. High. Canonical for the stalk-overwrite cluster.
follow_up_packet: Reachable: ReseedSilo.init at migration. No attacker; deterministic for any 2+ token holder. State before->after: final s.accts[account].stalk == only last-token stalk, prior tokens' stalk discarded. Guards fail: = instead of +=. Scope: silo reseed completeness, launch-blocking. Inspection-proven.

decision_reason: Confirmed in source: ReseedField.init inner loop header L49 `for (uint j; j < accountPlots[i].plots.length; i++)` increments outer i, not inner j. j never advances and i runs out of bounds -> revert (or non-terminating before OOB). Any reseed input containing plots reverts, so the one-shot Field migration cannot complete. Per policy, a one-shot init/migration routine that reverts is a launch blocker and at least High. Provable by inspection. Standalone (no live duplicate among the 48 bundles).
follow_up_packet: Reachable: ReseedField.init during diamondCut migration. No attacker; deterministic on any plotted input. State before->after: init reverts, Field never migrated. Guards fail: wrong loop counter. Scope: migration completeness, launch-blocking. Inspection-proven.

decision_reason: Confirmed: getTokenPriceFromExternal encodeType 0x01 returns 1e24.div(LibChainlinkOracle.getTokenPrice(...)) (L120-127) with NO zero-guard, while the WETH/WSTETH branches guard price==0. LibChainlinkOracle returns 0 (not revert) on a broken/frozen feed, so 1e24/0 reverts instead of degrading to the documented 0 sentinel, DoSing any consumer (peg/sunrise/convert pricing) of a 0x01 token during a feed outage. Conditional, external-feed-gated temporary DoS = Medium. Canonical for the oracle div-by-zero cluster.
follow_up_packet: Reachable: getUsdPrice/getTokenPriceFromExternal for a 0x01-registered token during a Chainlink outage. No attacker (feed condition). State: revert instead of 0-sentinel. Guards fail: missing zero-check before division. Scope: oracle; bounded to non-live 0x01 tokens, so Medium not High.

decision_reason: Confirmed: ReseedInternalBalances.setInternalBalances iterates i over farmers.length and reads balances[i] with no farmers.length==balances.length precondition; a short balances array reverts OOB, aborting the internal-balance reseed step (a longer one is caught by the totalInternalBalance guard). Privileged one-shot upgrade input, recoverable by resubmitting correct data. Best-practice/robustness Low. Canonical for the internal-balances length-check cluster.
follow_up_packet: Reachable: ReseedInternalBalances.init (privileged migration caller). No external attacker. State: OOB panic aborts the reseed step. Guards fail: missing length-equality require. Scope: migration robustness; recoverable. Low.

decision_reason: Confirmed: LibGauge.getAverageGrownStalkPerBdv computes stalk.div(totalBdv).sub(STALK_BDV_PRECISION) with checked .sub and no floor; if stalk/totalBdv < 1e4 the subtraction reverts, and getAverageGrownStalkPerBdv -> stepGauge runs inside sunrise/gm, so every season advance reverts. The depressed-ratio precondition is reachable post-migration via the LG-001/PC-001 desync. Standalone (precondition required) = Medium temporary season-freeze DoS per Immunefi v2.2; escalates toward High when chained with the migration desync.
follow_up_packet: Reachable: sunrise/gm -> stepGauge -> getAverageGrownStalkPerBdv. No privileged keys. State: checked .sub underflow reverts the season advance. Guards fail: no floor before sub. Scope: season progression DoS. Conditional on stalk/BDV<1e4 (reachable via migration desync).

decision_reason: Confirmed: LibFlood.floodPodline makes ~0.1% of Bean supply of Pods harvestable each flood season, consumed FIFO. Flood is permissionlessly triggerable via sunrise after Oversaturation, so an actor who accumulates front-of-line Pods can convert a controllable flood schedule into a near-deterministic harvest stream. Bounded (0.1%/season, public priced market) -> opportunistic reward-timing edge, not theft of principal. Medium per Immunefi v2.2 (bounded griefing/MEV advantage).
follow_up_packet: Reachable: sunrise/gm flood branch. No privileged keys. State: front pod-line positions ripen 0.1%/season to the holder. Guards fail: deterministic FIFO + permissionless flood timing. Scope: Field/flood incentives. Bounded -> Medium.

decision_reason: Confirmed: LibFlood.calculateSopPerWell final loop `for (i = positiveDeltaBCount; i > 0; i--)` executes `shaveToLevel += (shaveToLevel - uint(wellDeltaBs[i-1].deltaB)) / (i - 1)` inside the shave branch; on the last iteration i==1 so (i-1)==0 -> division-by-zero panic, reverting. calculateSopPerWell runs via LibFlood.handleRain inside sunrise/gm, so in a multi-well mixed-sign configuration where the branch is taken on the last (largest) positive well, the revert blocks that season's advancement. Conditional, configuration-dependent temporary sunrise DoS = Medium per Immunefi v2.2; currently bounded by few soppable wells. Distinct from EA-001/DS-003.
follow_up_packet: Reachable: sunrise/gm -> handleRain -> calculateSopPerWell in a flood with >=2 wells, mixed-sign deltaBs, shaveToLevel exceeding the largest positive well on the final step. No attacker required. State: div-by-zero panic reverts the season advance. Guards fail: divides by (i-1) which is 0 on i==1. Scope: season DoS. Conditional -> Medium.

decision_reason: Confirmed: LibUsdOracle.getTokenPrice WETH branch forwards lookback but the WSTETH branch hardcodes getWstethUsdPrice(0), dropping the caller's lookback so a TWAP request returns spot wstETH/USD. Sibling getUsdPrice forwards lookback for WSTETH, confirming this is an oversight. Weakens manipulation resistance for wstETH-priced consumers requesting a TWAP. Distinct function/token from BSA-001. Medium.
follow_up_packet: Reachable: getTokenPrice(wstETH, lookback>0). No privileged keys. State: returns spot instead of TWAP. Guards fail: hardcoded 0 lookback. Scope: oracle; impact when a consumer relies on the requested wstETH TWAP. Medium.

decision_reason: Confirmed: LibWstethEthOracle.getWstethEthPrice only assigns the price inside `if (getPercentDifference(chainlink, uniswap) < MAX_DIFFERENCE)` (1%) with no else/fallback, so on >=1% divergence it returns 0. A 0 propagates as oracle-failure (getUsdPrice 0 -> minting oracle off / LibDeltaB revert), pausing BEAN:WSTETH minting and conversions exactly during volatility. Conditional availability DoS = Medium. The NatSpec describes a richer fallback policy the code does not implement.
follow_up_packet: Reachable: any wstETH-well pricing during a >=1% Chainlink/Uniswap divergence (stETH depeg/volatility). No attacker required. State: oracle returns 0 -> deltaB=0 / convert revert. Guards fail: no else branch / fallback. Scope: wstETH well availability. Medium.

decision_reason: Confirmed: LibChainlinkOracle validates only roundId!=0 + timestamp/answer freshness; it never checks answeredInRound>=roundId and applies no min/max sanity bounds, and uses a 4h timeout on feeds documented as 1h heartbeat. Carried-over stale rounds within 4h and circuit-breaker pinned prices are accepted. Chainlink is a trusted source and the 0-on-failure design handles outages, so impact is a minor staleness/bounds best-practice gap = Low.
follow_up_packet: Reachable: any getPrice consumer during a stale/pinned Chainlink round. No attacker control. State: slightly-wrong price accepted. Guards fail: no answeredInRound / min-max bounds. Scope: oracle hardening. Low.

decision_reason: Confirmed: TractorFacet does not inherit Invariable (FarmFacet and DepotFacet do, with fundsSafu), yet tractor() executes an arbitrary AdvancedFarmCall[] batch as the publisher with only verifyRequisition+runBlueprint and no wrapper-level fundsSafu/flow guard. Inner guarded facets re-check fundsSafu, but there is no batch-level net solvency assertion, so an interleaving solvent at each inner checkpoint yet net-adverse across the batch, or an unguarded inner sink, executes with no final check. Genuine asymmetric guard gap (defense-in-depth) = Medium. Distinct from RE-001 (guard architecture vs reentrancy seam).
follow_up_packet: Reachable: TractorFacet.tractor with a crafted blueprint. Publisher-authorized (not arbitrary EOA against others). State: batch executes with no wrapper fundsSafu. Guards fail: TractorFacet lacks Invariable inheritance. Scope: solvency defense-in-depth. Medium.

decision_reason: Confirmed: LibTractor._domainSeparatorV4 uses BLUEPRINT_TYPE_HASH as the domain typehash instead of the defined EIP712_TYPE_HASH, producing a non-standard domain separator. No auth bypass/replay results: the same non-standard separator is used by both signer-recovery and verifier, chainId is included, and a per-blueprint nonce with maxNonce bounds replay. Impact is standards/interoperability: signatures from standard EIP-712 tooling won't verify (self-DoS of legitimate signers). Low. Not safety-net (no protocol-protection role); valid Low correctness finding.
follow_up_packet: Reachable: any standards-compliant signer producing a Tractor blueprint signature. No privileged keys. State: signature fails to verify against the non-standard separator. Guards fail: wrong typehash constant. Scope: EIP-712 interoperability. Low.

decision_reason: Confirmed by grep over beanstalk/init/: NO write to s.sys.silo.stalk or s.sys.silo.roots anywhere in the reseed/init tree (only per-account s.accts[].stalk in ReseedSilo L164). After the L2 reseed, accounts hold stalk but globals are 0. Consumers: burnActiveStalk/transferStalk divide by s.sys.silo.stalk (div-by-zero revert -> withdrawal/transfer freeze), mintActiveStalk takes the roots==0 genesis branch (first mower captures disproportionate roots), _balanceOfEarnedBeans mis-scaled. Protocol-wide invariant break with no attacker required. High. Canonical for the global-stalk/roots-uninitialized cluster.
follow_up_packet: Reachable: self-triggers on reseed; first post-migration withdraw/transfer/plant. No privileged keys. State before->after: s.sys.silo.stalk==0, s.sys.silo.roots==0 while sum(s.accts[].stalk) large. Guards fail: no init writes the aggregates. Scope: silo+sun migration completeness. PoC: post-reseed, call burn/transfer path and show div-by-zero revert, or first depositor minting genesis-scale roots.

decision_reason: Confirmed structure: LibFlood handleRain (flood branch) sizes SOP from getWellsByDeltaB -> currentDeltaB(well) -> getReserves (INSTANTANEOUS spot reserves, not the cumulative-pump TWAP the mint uses), then sopWell mints and swaps with minAmountOut=0 / deadline=max. Flood is permissionlessly triggerable via sunrise/gm after an Oversaturation season, so an attacker controls timing: skew the well to inflate sopBeans and sandwich the zero-slippage swap, capturing value owed to stalkholders. Permissionless economic leak = High; magnitude needs a state-flip PoC. Distinct from the mint path (FL-002 confirms mint is TWAP-defended).
follow_up_packet: Reachable: permissionless sunrise/gm in a flood season. No privileged keys. State before->after: attacker pre-skews well reserves, sopBeans inflated, zero-minAmountOut swap sandwiched; stalkholder plenty (rewardSop) reduced. Guards fail: instantaneous reserves + minAmountOut=0. Scope: SOP economics. PoC: flash-skew well, trigger flood, measure attacker profit vs stalkholder shortfall.

decision_reason: Confirmed structure: LibPipelineConvert measures before/after deltaB for the stalk penalty via uncapped instantaneous spot reserves (LibDeltaB.currentDeltaB -> getReserves, ZERO_LOOKBACK), while the convert-capacity ceiling uses the capped Multi-Flow pump. Since pipelineConvert runs attacker-supplied advancedFarmCalls between the two snapshots, the attacker can skew uncapped spot deltaB to understate against-peg movement and zero the stalkPenaltyBdv (require(stalkPenaltyBdv==0) passes), keeping more grown stalk than the capped design intends. Relative governance/yield gain, not direct unbacked mint -> Medium. Needs a PoC proving the skew zeroes the penalty. Distinct finding (safety_net=false).
follow_up_packet: Reachable: ConvertFacet.convert / pipelineConvert. No privileged keys (flash loan). State before->after: stalkPenaltyBdv computed 0 on skewed spot reserves vs >0 on capped reserves; user retains extra grownStalk. Guards fail: penalty measured on uncapped spot, capacity on capped pump. Scope: convert accounting. PoC required to confirm magnitude/reachability.

decision_reason: Confirmed structure: FarmFacet.farm/advancedFarm, DepotFacet pipe family, TractorFacet.tractor and LibPipelineConvert.executeAdvancedFarmCalls carry NO nonReentrant; the shared diamond guard is only set by guarded callers, so entering through one of these arbitrary-call entrypoints leaves the flag unset, allowing reentry into other unguarded state-mutating functions (sow/harvest/sunrise/mintFertilizer) mid-batch while internal accounting is transiently inconsistent. Invariable defends token custody but NOT internal accounting (stalk/deltaB/season) read mid-batch. No direct drain is traced from reentrancy alone, but this is the structural seam the economic/oracle vectors ride; cannot be cleared without a traced consumer. Medium, routed to PoC to confirm a mid-batch state-read exploit.
follow_up_packet: Reachable: FarmFacet.farm / DepotFacet.advancedPipe / TractorFacet.tractor with an attacker callback. No privileged keys. State: reentry reaches unguarded sow/harvest/sunrise/mintFertilizer while outer batch mid-execution. Guards fail: no nonReentrant on these entrypoints; Invariable only checks custody. PoC: demonstrate a mid-batch inconsistent-state read converted to value.
